selection.pedestrian_entry: First 12 scene IDs in seed-42 benchmark_regression, retaining both 500 and 1500 ms rules; reconstruct and verify archived P2 prompts and image hashes
selection.position_hold: First 12 profile IDs in frozen test.jsonl, rotation 0 and interval_maxima, retaining both 500 and 2000 ms rules; verify archived P2 constraint text

mutations.duration_change: Swap between the two supported task durations in the candidate specification only
mutations.reverse_comparison: Reverse the entry-time inequality, or the hold-radius inequality at the hold endpoint only
mutations.delete_release: Remove the temporal entry gate, or omit the hold release by extending radial restrictions to every listed post-hold sample
mutations.unit_error: Change the specification time unit from ms to s without rescaling values
mutations.cnl_duration: Replace all occurrences of the hold/wait duration with the other supported duration in the rendered sentence
mutations.cnl_negation: Remove Do not from the entry prohibition, or insert not into the hold-radius requirement
mutations.shared_source_error: Swap supported duration in both the candidate specification and trusted source record

evaluation_additions: fixed-grammar parsers for the two learning specifications
independent rule probes and result aggregation
checks.pedestrian_probes: Archived action candidates and +/-1 ms plus exact boundary, with entry and non-entry
checks.hold_probes: Archived action candidates and 199/200/201 mm at every listed noninitial sample, including post-release samples; diagonal boundary and norm checks
checks.unknown: Report separately and reject; do not count as a proved semantic mismatch

protocol.units: Integer milliseconds and millimetres; exact squared-distance reference
